verdict.description: REWORK if any finding has severity Blocker, or if the change cannot be judged correct from the diff and the available evidence.

summary.description: What was reviewed and the overall assessment, in a few sentences.

verification.description: What evidence of correctness exists - the Developer's recorded test results, CI status, coverage. State plainly where evidence is absent.

probed.description: The failure modes actively probed, and what happened. A clean review must still name what was checked.

spec_compliance.description: Each acceptance criterion mapped to the code that implements it and the test that proves it. Name criteria with code but no test, and criteria with neither.
